faq.q: What is Princess Robot Bubblegum in GTA 6?
faq.a: Princess Robot Bubblegum is an in-game media title listed for GTA 6 on the GTA Fandom wiki. The wiki entry is the only record of it. Rockstar has not named it in a trailer, a press release or on the Grand Theft Auto VI site, so this page records the wiki listing and marks it as a community source.

faq.q: Is Princess Robot Bubblegum confirmed for GTA 6?
faq.a: No. A Fandom wiki page is written by fans, not by Rockstar. This site files Princess Robot Bubblegum as community identified, at low confidence, for that reason. The entry stays at low confidence until Rockstar or a major outlet names it.

faq.q: What is still unknown about Princess Robot Bubblegum?

faq.q: Will Princess Robot Bubblegum be in the finished GTA 6?
